text: Not heavy duty, not really any better than a trash bag except that it has a shape to be joe T!. On one hand these are great because they actually hold a lot and hold form. But, they are NOT heavy duty. A few came in with holes where it was not sewn properly. I have to send them all back just to get 2 replacements. Kind of a bummer. 🤷‍♀️
